title: Android 1.15.0 download
summary: The website's Android download is now version 1.15.0, with the new map tools and history on demand built into the app.
items: Downloads offers Android 1.15.0 with its checksum; install it over the existing app. The owner widget keeps its connection.

The app now has the map's grid snapping and token sizes, players moving their own tokens, Place party, the press-and-hold radial, follow view, zones with party votes and Ask the DM, plus Load earlier entries for long campaigns.
